name: No real-time sanctions screening
description: Counterparties not screened at onboarding or transaction time.

name: Stale sanctions lists
description: Lists refreshed weekly or via manual upload.

name: No UBO-level screening
description: Only the contracting party is screened; underlying owners and controllers are not.

name: No adverse-media check
description: No periodic screen against adverse-media datasets to catch nominees / front entities.

name: No counterparty-jurisdiction screening
description: No automated check on counterparty country of registration / operation against sanctioned regimes.

name: No end-use / end-user verification
description: No documented end-use statement or check against restricted-purpose lists.

name: No supply-chain due diligence
description: Tier-2 / tier-3 suppliers not verified; circumvention via re-export goes undetected.

name: No OFAC / OFSI licence tracker
description: Licences and conditions not tracked centrally; activity-vs-scope not monitored.
